This game just feels great. If you enjoy racing games and find drifting fun this game will definitely scratch that itch.

Pros:
- Great music but there's only like 4 tracks
- Wide variety of cars and customizations 
- Layered decal system so you can go wild
- Online freeplay is cool, just a chill vibe drifting around with strangers
- In-game chat makes the game feel alive
- Still in active development

cons:
- Not a lot of tracks in the base game
- There's only like 3 gamemodes
- There doesn't seem to be a lot to do in multiplayer
- Just needs more variety of stuff to do.
